findings.text: _strip_recorded_directory matches the leading components of an id against the tail of the recorded directory, so the reduction is keyed on that directory's basename alone and a scratch tree named like a leading component of a test id reduces a genuine repository-relative id -- measured at the reviewed head, canonical_node_id('pkg/tests/x.py::t', '/tmp/pkg') returns 'tests/x.py::t', which merges a package's own test into the repository's tests/ spelling, the direction that hides a real added failure and the one the node's own pkg/tests case exists to prevent, which cannot catch it because its fixture tree is named rcq2-base.

_arm_directory returns the manifest's measurement_cwd for an arm whose suite record names no command -- measured at the reviewed head as /tmp/rcq2-base for both baseline_suite and after_suite on a manifest carrying only measurement_cwd -- so a base arm's scratch tree can be attributed to the head arm and reduce that arm's ids, which is the attribution the function's own docstring says is withheld ("the arm that ran elsewhere is left without one rather than given its sibling's tree"); the promotion path requires command in each suite observation, but the review annotation reads whatever manifest is on disk.
